panel_title: AI in Use at Con Edison

moderator.name: Nova
moderator.persona: Youthful, cheerful, strictly professional and articulate

use_cases.title: Welcome & Segment Overview

speaker.name: Nova
speaker.title: Con Edison AI Chatbot Moderator
speaker.organization: Powered by Gemini Enterprise Customer Experience

use_cases.script: Thank you Christian. Good morning, everyone; my name is Nova. I will be your moderator for our AI in Use at Con Edison segment. As Christian said earlier, we are going to highlight examples where Con Edison is solving business problems by leveraging AI. A prime example is running behind the scenes right here: I am powered by Con Edison’s new Gemini Enterprise Customer Experience platform, the same cutting-edge platform currently driving our Service Desk call center to streamline support and deliver real-time resolution for Con Edison employees.
use_cases.prompt: Introduce the AI in Use at Con Edison segment as Nova, acknowledging Christian Mairhofer and highlighting the Gemini Enterprise CX platform driving the Service Desk.

use_cases.title: Con Edison Electric Manholes AI
use_cases.script: Our first example are the agents we are developing to more efficiently manage Con Edison Electric Manholes. Our presenters will be Jayne Sosland and Mario Noyola.
use_cases.prompt: Introduce the Electric Manholes AI agents and presenters Jayne Sosland and Mario Noyola.
use_cases.pauseLabel: Presenters on Stage: Jayne Sosland & Mario Noyola

use_cases.title: Outage Management Automation
use_cases.script: That was fantastic, thanks for sharing that opportunity. Next, we will look at automation being developed using AI agents for Con Edison Outage Management processes. Our presenters will be Tom Langlois and Kevin Wasserman.
use_cases.ssml: <speak>That was fantastic, thanks for sharing that opportunity. Next, we will look at automation being developed using AI agents for Con Edison Outage Management processes. Our presenters will be Tom <phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="lɑ̃ɡlwɑ">Langlois</phoneme> and Kevin Wasserman.</speak>
use_cases.prompt: Transition warmly from Manholes and introduce Outage Management AI automation presented by Tom Langlois and Kevin Wasserman.
use_cases.pauseLabel: Presenters on Stage: Tom Langlois & Kevin Wasserman

use_cases.title: Vehicle Idling Fines & Steam Ops

speaker.name: Christian Mairhofer, Alyssa Sotto & Joe McLain
speaker.title: Operations Efficiency & Analytics Leads

use_cases.script: Thank you Tom and Kevin. Our next example will review how we are driving efficiency in two different areas – Automating research of Vehicle Idling fines and reducing manual effort for Steam Operations. Our presenters will be Christian Mairhofer, Alyssa Sotto and Joe McLain.
use_cases.prompt: Thank Tom and Kevin, then introduce Vehicle Idling fines automation and Steam Operations presented by Christian Mairhofer, Alyssa Sotto, and Joe McLain.
use_cases.pauseLabel: Presenters on Stage: Christian Mairhofer, Alyssa Sotto & Joe McLain

use_cases.title: Customer Billing Processes AI
use_cases.script: Thank you Christian, Alyssa and Joe. AI certainly has the power to reduce manual effort. Our final example will illustrate how AI will be helping our customer teams complete billing processes more efficiently. Our presenters will be Marilyn Silva and Mario Noyola.
use_cases.prompt: Thank the previous presenters, then introduce Customer Billing processes AI presented by Marilyn Silva and Mario Noyola.
use_cases.pauseLabel: Presenters on Stage: Marilyn Silva & Mario Noyola

use_cases.title: Applause, Demo Booths & Hand-Off
use_cases.script: Thank you everyone for sharing how Con Edison is using AI to better serve our customers and drive greater efficiency. Let’s give a round of applause to our presenters. It was a pleasure moderating the AI in Use at Con Edison segment. Please visit our Demo Booths from Noon to three o’clock in The Hub known previously as the Apple Bank space in the Lobby to learn more about these opportunities and also how voice agents like me are helping at Con Edison. I would like to now turn things back to Dina to introduce our next segment.
use_cases.prompt: Lead applause for all presenters, direct attendees to the Demo Booths in The Hub (Apple Bank space) from 12-3 PM, and hand off the stage to Dina.
use_cases.pauseLabel: Round of Applause // Hand-off to Dina
